description_en: Applies an account baseline to multiple existing resource accounts at a time
description_zh: 批量为已有的资源账号应用账号基线
kebab_example: aliyun governance batch-enroll-accounts --accounts AccountUid=128681561790000 --baseline-items Version=1.0 Config=Notifications_:_GroupKey_:_account_msg_,_Contacts_:_Name_:_aa_,_PmsgStatus_:1,_EmailStatus_:1,_SmsStatus_:1 Skip=false Name=ACS-BP_ACCOUNT_FACTORY_VPC --baseline-id afb-bp1durvn3lgqe28v0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchEnrollAccounts

fields.help_en: The ID of the account to enroll. This parameter is required
fields.name: account_uid

fields.help_en: The configurations of the baseline item
fields.name: config

fields.help_en: The name of the baseline item
fields.name: name

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to skip the baseline item. Valid values:

false (default): does not skip the baseline item.

true: skips the baseline item
fields.help_zh:
是否跳过基线项。取值：

false：不跳过。
true：跳过
fields.name: skip

fields.help_en: The version of the baseline item
fields.name: version

parameters.help_en:
The baseline items.

If you specify this parameter, the baseline item configurations are merged with the configurations of the baseline specified by `BaselineId`. For duplicate baseline items, the configurations in this parameter take precedence. We recommend that you leave this parameter empty and use `BaselineId` to apply baseline configurations
parameters.help_zh:
基线项配置数组。

如果传递了该参数，那么基线项的配置将和指定账号基线进行合并。相同的基线项将以该参数的配置为准。建议您将该参数置空，通过`BaselineId`参数指定账号基线，通过现有基线将配置应用到账号上
parameters.name: baseline_items

parameters.help_en: The ID of the baseline. If you leave this parameter empty, the default baseline is used
parameters.help_zh:
基线ID。

置空则默认使用系统默认基线
parameters.name: baseline_id
